entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David, agent ID 304. How can I help you today?
Finally! I've been on hold forever. I bought this jersey a month ago and it's completely useless. I want my money back. This is ridiculous.
I can certainly look into that for you, and I apologize for the wait time. So I can pull up your order, could I get your name and order number?
The name is Mark Sterling. Order number is VF98754. Don't waste my time, David. Just process the return. It's the wrong size, it's unbelievably tight, and I can't even move in it.

Okay, Mr. Sterling, I have your order right here. I see the Pro-Line jersey, delivered on November 14th. I understand it's too tight. Just to be sure, is it a technical fault with the material, or a preference issue with the fit?

Are you kidding me? A 'preference issue'? I told you it's the wrong size! Your sizing chart is a joke. I want to return this garbage jersey and I want to do it now. If you can't handle this, put a manager on the phone. I'm one click away from leaving a review that will scorch your company.

My apologies, sir, I didn't mean to suggest the fault was yours. I just needed to classify the issue. Please give me one moment to review our policy for you. I don't think a manager will be necessary.
Unbelievable. Fine. You have 30 seconds before I hang up and blast you on social media.

Thank you for your patience. Okay, I've checked the policy. It looks like your purchase is well within our 90-day return window. We can absolutely process this for you. Would you prefer a full refund, or would you like me to process an exchange for a larger size?
Oh. Well... that's... okay then. So you can just take it back? No problem?

Yes, absolutely. Since it's a sizing issue, I can start the exchange process for the next size up right now, or I can email you a pre-paid return label for a full refund to your original payment method. The choice is yours.
Alright, alright. Good. Let's just do the refund. I'll find something else. Send me the label.

Of course. I've just sent that return shipping label to the email address on file. Just print it out, attach it to the package, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive the jersey, your refund will be processed within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today, Mr. Sterling?
No, that's it. That's all I needed. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
